subject: Scheduling: Full loop for Samira Khan — panel ordering & debrief ownership
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@talentbridge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Full loop for Samira Khan — proposed windows

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks for taking this. We have Samira Khan (resume attached) excited to move to a full virtual onsite. She can do either Sep 28 or Sep 29 (PDT) — we put both dates on hold on her side.

High-level ask: 4 interviews, each 50 minutes, plus a 30-minute debrief. Prefer coordinating across two halves of a day (AM technical block, PM cross-functional + wrap).

Attached: Samira_Khan_Resume.pdf and a brief panel pack with role context.

Quick questions for you:
- Do you want us to cluster by competency (systems/product/collab) or by function (backend/frontend/pm)?
- Who should own the debrief and notes?

If helpful I can propose concrete slots once you confirm the sequencing preference.

Best,
Ava Collins
Senior Recruiter | TalentBridge
[Attachment: Samira_Khan_Resume.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: panel_pack_v2.pdf (PDF)]
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Full loop for Samira Khan — proposed windows

Thanks Ava — appreciate the quick turnaround.

We should sequence by domain rather than strict function. My preference:
1) Systems design (broad architecture) — helps warm up candidate for deep dives
2) Backend deep-dive (service design + data)
3) Product-architecture / tradeoffs (PM or Eng-PM hybrid)
4) Culture & collaboration / hiring manager + cross-functional partner

Rationale: starting broad reduces context switching for interviewers who will ask cross-cutting questions.

Debrief: I can own the debrief as facilitator, but I’d like an official note-taker. Laura or Marissa, can one of you be the scribe and own the debrief doc? If Marissa can take notes, I’ll run the 30-min debrief immediately after the last interview.

Proposed concrete windows (all PDT):
- AM block: 09:00–11:40 (two 50-min interviews with 10-min breaks)
- Lunch / buffer: 11:40–12:40
- PM block: 12:40–15:10 (two 50-min interviews + 10-min breaks)
- Debrief: 15:20–15:50

If that works, Ava — can you lock Samira for Sep 28 and send calendar invites (Google Meet pref)?

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Mateo — thanks, that sequence looks good to me. A few practical notes:

- For the backend deep-dive, will Marcus Lin or Karthik Iyer be the best fit? If Marcus is available, please slot him for the second slot.
- For product-architecture, I’ll join as the PM partner and focus on product tradeoffs + metrics.
- Happy to have Marissa take notes; Marissa, can you confirm you’ll own the debrief doc and capture action items?

Also: let’s keep the interview order flexible in case Samira has a strong time preference in the morning vs afternoon. The OR gating is: keep systems design before the deep-dive so context flows.

Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Full loop for Samira Khan — proposed windows

Quick add — putting systems design first is solid, but a small tweak: swap the order of slots 2 and 3 (product-architecture before backend deep-dive). Two reasons:
1) Product context primes the candidate for backend tradeoffs (data retention, latency vs cost).
2) Our backend interviewer (Marcus) is often better mid-day when he’s not in the early standups. If Marcus confirms he prefers midday we can lock that.

Also, can we keep the debrief immediately after the last interview (15:20) and keep it as synchronous 30-min? I’ll attend but won’t be the note-taker.

—Jonas
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@example.com>

Hi all — thanks for coordinating. Sep 28 works perfectly for me. I don’t need any special accommodations, but I do prefer the earlier technical slot if possible.

Could you also confirm: will interviews be recorded for internal calibration? And will there be a short break between interviews (10 minutes should be fine)?

Looking forward to it — Samira
